components.name: Product Card

components.css: .ds-product-card { display:block; width:280px; border-radius:1.35rem; background:var(--card, #fff); color:var(--card-foreground, #1b1c1c); padding:10px; font-family:'Noto Sans Georgian Variable','Manrope Variable',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(59,40,27,.06); } .ds-product-image { display:grid; aspect-ratio:4/3; place-items:center; overflow:hidden; border-radius:1.05rem; background:#f0eded; color:#a89082; transition:transform 500ms ease-out; } .ds-product-copy { padding:16px 8px 8px; } .ds-product-meta { overflow:hidden; color:#83746b; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-product-card h3 { min-height:48px; margin:6px 0 0; font-size:16px; line-height:24px; font-weight:600; } .ds-product-card strong { display:block; margin-top:12px; color:var(--primary, #7f512f); font-size:18px; } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-image { transform:scale(1.025); } .ds-product-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #7f512f); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-product-card:active { box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(59,40,27,.06); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-product-image { transition:none; } }

components.css: .ds-category-card { display:flex; min-height:96px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; border-radius:1.35rem; background:var(--card, #fff); color:var(--card-foreground, #1b1c1c); padding:20px; font-family:'Noto Sans Georgian Variable','Manrope Variable',sans-serif; font-size:20px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.02em; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(59,40,27,.05); transition:transform 150ms ease; } .ds-category-card i { display:grid; width:44px; height:44px; flex:none; place-items:center; border-radius:1.05rem; background:var(--secondary, #f6f3f2); color:var(--primary, #7f512f); font-style:normal; transition:background-color 150ms ease,color 150ms ease; } .ds-category-card:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-category-card:hover i { background:var(--primary, #7f512f); color:#fff; } .ds-category-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #7f512f); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-category-card:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: A familiar four-link navigation whose Walnut underline signals hover and active state.
components.html: მთავარიპროდუქტებიჩვენ შესახებკონტაქტი
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; font-family:'Noto Sans Georgian Variable','Manrope Variable',sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { position:relative; display:flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; padding:0 4px; color:var(--muted-foreground, #605e5b); font-size:14px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition:color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { position:absolute; right:4px; bottom:0; left:4px; height:2px; background:var(--primary, #7f512f); content:''; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover,.ds-nav-link.ds-active { color:var(--primary, #7f512f); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after,.ds-nav-link.ds-active::after { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #7f512f); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-nav-link:active { color:#6d4528; }

components.css: .ds-hero { position:relative; display:flex; min-height:420px; align-items:center; overflow:hidden; border-radius:1.35rem; background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(30,21,16,.72),rgba(30,21,16,.24)),linear-gradient(135deg,#8f7867,#d9d3ce 72%); padding:40px; color:#fff; font-family:'Noto Sans Georgian Variable','Manrope Variable',sans-serif; } .ds-hero-content { max-width:640px; } .ds-hero h1 { max-width:13ch; margin:0; font-size:clamp(38px,5.2vw,68px); line-height:1.08; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-hero p { max-width:512px; margin:20px 0 0; color:rgba(255,255,255,.85); font-size:16px; line-height:28px; } .ds-hero-action { min-height:48px; margin-top:28px; border:0; border-radius:1.05rem; background:#7f512f; color:#fff; padding:12px 24px; font:600 14px 'Noto Sans Georgian Variable','Manrope Variable',sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-hero-action:hover { background:#6d4528; } .ds-hero-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-hero-controls { position:absolute; right:32px; bottom:24px; left:32px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; } .ds-hero-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:999px; background:#fff; opacity:.55; } .ds-hero-dot.ds-selected { width:28px; opacity:1; } .ds-hero-controls button { display:grid; width:44px; height:44px; margin-left:auto; place-items:center; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45); border-radius:1.05rem; background:rgba(0,0,0,.2); color:#fff; transition:background-color 150ms ease,color 150ms ease; } .ds-hero-controls button:hover { background:#fff; color:#1b1c1c; } .ds-hero-controls button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-hero-controls button:active { background:#f6f3f2; }

narrative.overview:
Home Mix feels like entering a comfortable, well-kept home: warm, calm, and immediately understandable. Natural furniture photography carries the atmosphere, while a restrained off-white, white, and walnut palette keeps the interface familiar and lets real products remain the point.

The system is polished through proportion, spacing, legible Georgian typography, and quiet interaction states rather than decorative concepts. It favors straightforward storefront patterns and moderate density; experimental grids, technical annotations, oversized display treatments, and visually complicated compositions are outside this world.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral canvas with walnut-brown actions
Natural room and product photography as the main visual voice
Real products presented before category navigation
Familiar cards, navigation, and controls with soft corners
Restrained motion and clearly visible keyboard focus

rules.name: The One Walnut Rule
rules.body: Walnut is the only chromatic accent for ordinary actions and emphasis; the rest of the interface stays neutral so furniture imagery remains dominant.

rules.name: The Warm Canvas Rule
rules.body: Large page surfaces use Warm Canvas or Soft Linen, while pure white is reserved for contained cards and controls.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the Georgian-first sans stack everywhere and create hierarchy with size, weight, and spacing rather than introducing a contrasting display typeface.

rules.name: The Furniture Leads Rule
rules.body: Headlines are concise and controlled; typography never competes with room or product imagery for attention.

rules.name: The Product-First Rule
rules.body: On discovery surfaces, show real products before category navigation unless the task has a stronger product reason to change the sequence.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Resting cards use warm ambient shadows below 0.07 opacity; pronounced elevation belongs only to temporary overlays.

dos: Do let real room and product photography carry the first impression.
Do keep products ahead of categories on storefront discovery pages.
Do use Warm Canvas for the page and white for contained product or navigation surfaces.
Do preserve 44px minimum controls, visible focus outlines, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use straightforward responsive grids and the established 1rem / 1.5rem / 2rem page gutters.
donts: Don't add drafting grids, measurements, registration marks, numbered metadata, or technical-looking navigation devices.
Don't introduce dark catalog sections or decorative color fields that overpower product photography.
Don't use oversized compressed headlines, ornamental display type, or copy-heavy layouts.
Don't turn categories into the primary homepage story ahead of real products.
Don't add speculative commerce UI or fabricated proof to make the storefront feel fuller.
